messages:
Alex: heads up — seeing a ~6% 5xx spike on /v2/generate after the rollforward this morning. impact on a handful of customer requests. requesting expedited hotfix deploy or rollback. pinging @Meera and @Jon for SRE signoff.
Meera: on it. what's the release tag? any quick mitigation (traffic pin, scale)?
Alex: tag=release/2026-03-10-hotfix. Canary started at 5% earlier. Linking runbook: https://confluence.redwood/example-runbook
deploy-bot: Canary report: release/2026-03-10-hotfix -> traffic=5% / failures=5.8% / latency_p90=420ms. Tests: smoke failed on user-service downstream connection.
Jon: seeing same in prometheus: https://prometheus/redwood/alerts/2345 error_rate spike at 09:14. DB connection pool exhaustion traces starting around 09:09. Prefer rollback to last-stable (release/2026-03-03) to restore service quickly.
Paige: how many customers impacted? is this user-facing? we should prioritize quick restore.
Alex: top 3 customers with real traffic impacted; escalation in support. Agree rollback is fastest if it's a built-time issue. If the patch is a single-line cherry-pick I can push a hotfix in ~10-15m.
Ryan: infra note — if we rollback we'll need to pin autoscaler to avoid flapping. Also recommend disabling batching in runtime for the hotfix path (set batch_size=1) while we validate.
Meera: quick triage: the failing calls show intermittent TLS handshake + client conn leak in logs from user-service. If Alex's patch addresses leak, patch deploy acceptable. Need 2 approvals for expedited from SRE + Eng-Infra.
Alex: created PR https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/8812 (cherry-pick + small guard) commit abc1234. Requesting expedited approval: @Jon @Ryan please reply "+1" if you approve immediate deploy to canary then ramp.
Jon: +1 from SRE in favor of rollout of patched image, but if smoke fails roll back immediately. I'll be standing by.
Ryan: +1 infra — will pin autoscaler rule and set batch_size=1 during rollout. Also make sure KV cache is disabled for the patch.
Meera: running a quick smoke against the PR image.
Meera: ```
$ curl -sv -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" https://api.redwood/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
* Connected to api.redwood
> POST /v2/generate
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"id":"res_abc","status":"success"}
``` 
Meera: smoke looks green from my side after 2m of traffic. no 5xx in the last 120s.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release=release/2026-03-10-hotfix-pr8812 target=canary traffic=5% actor=alex
deploy-bot: Canary passed checks -> ramping to 25% (metrics stable)
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 25% passed -> ramping to 100%
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: release/2026-03-10-hotfix-pr8812 -> production. Rollback window: 10m
Alex: rolling monitoring and will notify if anything unusual. Thanks @Jon @Ryan for expedited approvals. Follow-up: postmortem scheduled + retro to avoid repeat.
Paige: thanks team — please update release notes with rollback rationale and customer impact.
Alex: closing thread — incident mitigated, follow-up postmortem at 2026-03-11 11:00 in #postmortems. :tada:
